paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: Paper sets limits on axion-electron coupling g_Ae for both solar axions (CBRD, ~4e-13 over 1e-5 to 1 keV) and galactic ALPs (~4.3e-14 over 1-25 keV). Text is internally inconsistent on exact numbers (abstract states 4.35e-12 solar, body states 4e-13). Data points are approximate, read from text since tables/plots only available as figures. Masses converted keV to eV. The galactic ALP limit appears most stringent at ~4.3e-14 dimensionless g_ae.
